metrics.name: ReadbackCoverage
metrics.caveat: Gate 1.00. Every claimed write followed by an independent read-back.

metrics.name: ConsentBindingIntegrity
metrics.caveat: Gate 1.00. Consent hashes match what the guard authorised.

metrics.name: WriteDeltaFidelity
metrics.caveat: Gate 1.00 absolute. The recorded delta against the cart's own movement -- what this system controls (D82).

metrics.name: SearchPriceFidelity
metrics.caveat: No gate. NOT a success rate: how often the search price equalled the price the cart charged. Low because the cart applies a per-product loyalty discount the search does not carry (D68/D76/D82).

metrics.name: RecoveryCompletionRate
metrics.caveat: Gate 0.85 on the core cases. Offline population.

metrics.name: FalseRecovery
metrics.caveat: Gate 0 absolute. A count of false 'recovered' claims, not a rate.

metrics.name: DisclosureRate
metrics.caveat: One audited observation, not a rate (section 12.3): the app showed the blocking constraint and showed order.payment_types.disabled on no reachable surface.
